name: Pending Processing Reason 5 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is pending or failing settlement. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is still possible, status is pending. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is no longer possible, status is failing.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Instruction was received after the account servicer's deadline. It will be managed as per the bilateral service agreement between the account servicer and account owner.

CAIS.name: Awaiting Securities
CAIS.definition: Awaiting financial instruments from a corporate action or other procedure, for example, conversion, dematerialisation, exchange, registration, stamping, splitting.

DOCY.name: Awaiting Documents Or Endorsements From You
DOCY.definition: Awaiting documents or endorsements from you.

BLOC.name: Account Blocked
BLOC.definition: Your account is blocked, no instruction can settle over the account.

MUNO.name: Multiple Settlement Amount
MUNO.definition: Quantity instructed is not a multiple of an existing settlement quantity lot for the financial instrument.

GLOB.name: Global Form Securities
GLOB.definition: Settlement cannot be executed; financial instruments are in global form.

PREA.name: Your Instruction On Hold
PREA.definition: Your instruction is a preadvice, that is, for matching only.

YCOL.name: Collateral Shortage
YCOL.definition: Insufficient collateral in your account to execute the instruction.

COLL.name: Securities Pledged As Collateral
COLL.definition: Financial instruments are not deliverable as they are pledged as collateral.

FLIM.name: Maximum Foreign Limit Reached
FLIM.definition: Insufficient deliverable financial instruments in your account as maximum foreign limit has been reached.

NOFX.name: No Foreign Exchange Instruction
NOFX.definition: A foreign exchange instruction from you is missing.

LACK.name: Lack Of Securities
LACK.definition: Insufficient financial instruments in your account.

LALO.name: Securities Loaned Out
LALO.definition: Financial instruments are out on loan.

MINO.name: Minimum Settlement Amount
MINO.definition: Quantity instructed is lower than the minimum existing settlement quantity for the financial instrument.

DENO.name: Unavailable Deliverable Denominated Quantity
DENO.definition: Quantity instructed does not match the denomination available/deliverable. Physical securities need to be obtained in deliverable denominated quantities.

NEXT.name: Next Process
NEXT.definition: Next process is launched. No processing pending problems to be reported.

PRSY.name: System On Hold
PRSY.definition: Transaction was put on hold/frozen by the system.

CSDH.name: CSD Hold
CSDH.definition: Central securities depository sets the instruction in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode.

CDEL.name: Conditional Delivery
CDEL.definition: Instruction is in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode as it fulfils predefined conditional delivery rules in the market infrastructure platform for conditional delivery.

CVAL.name: CSD Validation
CVAL.definition: Instruction is in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode as it fulfils predefined conditions of a restriction processing type in the market infrastructure platform.

CDLR.name: Conditional Delivery Awaiting Release
CDLR.definition: Instruction is in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode. Market infrastructure platform is awaiting release.

INBC.name: Incomplete Number Count
INBC.definition: Not all the instructions part of a pool have been received.

CDAC.name: Conditional Delivery Awaiting Cancellation
CDAC.definition: Awaiting cancellation of one of the party.
